svg.title: Buy the Exit Before You Buy the Lot
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-surplus-to-collected-resale; chart type: process_flow; title: Buy the Exit Before You Buy the Lot; subtitle: Five operating stages from auction discovery to collected resale; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: GSA Auctions, GovPlanet, GovDeals, and Public Surplus are discovery channels, not interchangeable sellers or uniform contract regimes. Verify the actual seller, governing sale terms, and asset restrictions for every lot. Revenue means the operator's gross resale proceeds, not auction-platform transaction volume.; caption: A low hammer price creates no profit until removal, condition, documentation, and buyer payment are resolved.; stages: label: Source qualified lots; value: Alerts plus buyer demand; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Configure auction alerts by equipment class, pickup radius, closing date, and seller. Match each candidate to recent resale evidence and named prospective business buyers before requesting inspection.; label: Inspect and price; value: Evidence-backed bid ceiling; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Record serial numbers, condition, title documents, loading constraints, and removal deadlines. Set the hammer ceiling from expected collected resale less fees, freight, repairs, labor, carrying costs, overhead allocation, and required profit.; label: Bid and settle; value: Commit within funded limits; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use a versioned bid-limit worksheet; reserve cash for the full invoice and removal plan before bidding. Validate payment instructions through the auction account and seller contact details before sending a bank payment.; label: Remove and prepare; value: Document custody and condition; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Book the carrier within the contractual pickup window. Photograph condition at release and receipt, attach costs to the inventory record, and stop repairs when the remaining resale contribution falls below the approved floor.; label: Remarket and collect; value: Close the asset-level ledger; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Publish tested specifications and disclosed defects, execute the applicable title or bill-of-sale transfer, verify payment receipt rather than screenshots, and reconcile proceeds, direct costs, and inventory age.

circle.title: label: Source qualified lots; value: Alerts plus buyer demand; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Configure auction alerts by equipment class, pickup radius, closing date, and seller. text.title: Publish tested specifications and disclosed defects, execute the applicable title or bill-of-sale transfer, verify payment receipt rather than screenshots, and reconcile proceeds, direct costs, and inventory age.

Assumptions: GSA Auctions, GovPlanet, GovDeals, and Public Surplus are discovery channels, not interchangeable sellers or uniform contract regimes. Verify the actual seller, governing sale terms, and asset restrictions for every lot. Revenue means the operator's gross resale proceeds, not auction-platform transaction volume.
